scientific_limitations: Cyclic simple prism graphs with n at least 7; does not classify smaller prisms, wider grids, or non-optimal edge open packings. Novelty may be affected by nonindexed equivalent injective-edge-color-class or induced-star-forest results.
title: Exact mod-six edge open packing and optimal-set counts for cyclic prisms
